cases.title: The Missing Suitcase
cases.description: Locate the brown suitcase reported missing from the station lockers.

objectives.text: Find a way to contact the advertiser.
Investigate the disappearance of the suitcase.
Recover the suitcase and arrange its return.

initialItems.label: Missing suitcase. No questions.
initialItems.text: A concerned traveller is offering $120 for the return of a brown suitcase missing from the station lockers. The suitcase must remain unopened.

initialItems.label: Who placed the advertisement?
initialItems.text: The advertiser has not provided a direct telephone number.

cases.title: The Borrowed Alibi
cases.description: Find out why three strangers claim they had dinner with the advertiser.

objectives.text: Find a way to contact the advertiser at Box 17.
Identify the people using the client's alibi.
Establish what happened on Tuesday evening.

initialItems.label: Someone has been using my alibi
initialItems.text: The advertiser claims to have eaten alone on Tuesday. Three strangers reportedly say they were having dinner with the advertiser.

initialItems.label: Three strangers
initialItems.text: Their identities and reasons for using this alibi are unknown.
